  <!-- Illustration Rules Brief -->
  <section style="margin-bottom: 4rem;">
    <h2 style="font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-bottom:1.5rem; padding-bottom:0.75rem; border-bottom:2px solid var(--color-brand-navy);">
      Official Illustration Rules &amp; Characteristics
    </h2>
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap:1.5rem;">
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem;">
        <h4 style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-top:0;">✏️ Linework</h4>
        <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-brand-gray-600); line-height:1.5; margin:0;">
          Flat vector with bold, uniform black outlines. Zero grain, paper textures, or realistic gradients on characters. Clean, solid color fills only.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem;">
        <h4 style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-top:0;">😊 Characters</h4>
        <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-brand-gray-600); line-height:1.5; margin:0;">
          Simplified and friendly. Closed curved-line eyes and minimal facial features. Figures look approachable and warm, never photorealistic or hyper-detailed.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem;">
        <h4 style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-top:0;">☁️ Backgrounds</h4>
        <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-brand-gray-600); line-height:1.5; margin:0;">
          Large, soft geometric cloud silhouettes cropped at the canvas edges. Clean paneled split layouts with spacious breathing room.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem;">
        <h4 style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-top:0;">🎴 UI Elements</h4>
        <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-brand-gray-600); line-height:1.5; margin:0;">
          Floating rounded cards or circular plus buttons with hard, offset black drop shadows (no gaussian blur). Gives a tactical editorial feel.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem;">
        <h4 style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-top:0;">➖ Abstract Text</h4>
        <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-brand-gray-600); line-height:1.5; margin:0;">
          Shown strictly as horizontal black bars paired with shorter colored indicator bars. Never generate real letters or readable typography.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem;">
        <h4 style="font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-brand-navy); margin-top:0;">📐 Format &amp; Watermark</h4>
        <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--color-brand-gray-600); line-height:1.5; margin:0;">
          16:9 widescreen composition (1376x768). The bottom-right corner must always remain clear of characters so the Rainfall signet can be stamped.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

Scene: [ One sentence: who or what, doing what, plus one supporting UI element if applicable ]
